svg.title: Variational family limitations and KL direction
svg.desc: Left: correlated Gaussian contours and the narrower optimal diagonal Gaussian. Right: two posterior peaks, an illustrative Gaussian near one peak, and the broad forward-KL optimal Gaussian.
